The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. entre address shall be provided. 5. GeM Listing and Financial Turnover: The quoted product shall be listed on the GeM portal. The bidder shall have an average annual financial tu rnover of at least ₹2 crore during the last three financial years. Documentary evidence shall be submitted. 6. Clean Incident History: The bidder shall have a clean business record with no adverse or negative reputation. Supporting docume nts/self-declaration shall be furnished. 7. Seller Rating: The bidder's overall GeM rating shall not be less than 4.5. 8. Warranty Verification: Warranty details shall be verifiable on the OEM's official website. Scope of Price: The quoted price shall be inclusive of supply, delivery, and basic installation of all items. .
